appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Prevalence of Species Z in Each State'.
Legend is a vertical color bar on the right side of the chart, labeled '100 Low' at the top and '0 High' at the bottom.
Color scale ranges from light yellow (Low, 100) to dark red (High, 0).
States are shaded in varying intensities of red and orange based on prevalence.
Each state is labeled with its two-letter postal abbreviation.
The gradient transitions from light yellow to orange to dark red as prevalence decreases from low to high.
Dark red indicates the highest prevalence (value 0), while light yellow indicates the lowest prevalence (value 100).
States like Texas (TX), Illinois (IL), and Ohio (OH) are shaded in dark red, indicating high prevalence.
